name: FastSocial — Social Media Scheduler
author: fastsocial

sections.description:
FastSocial connects your WordPress site to your social media accounts, automatically sharing new posts the moment they go live — no copy-pasting, no switching tabs.

Free features:
* Auto-share new WordPress posts to your first connected platform
* Customizable post caption template (title, excerpt, URL, author, categories)
* Include featured image as post media
* Per-post override to skip sharing
* Works with all 7 major platforms: Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X/Twitter, TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube

Pro features ($20/month):
* Full scheduling calendar inside your WP dashboard
* Create and manage scheduled posts without leaving WordPress
* Multi-platform posting — post to all platforms at once
* FastSocial media library browser — use your uploaded images in posts
* 109 language support

How it works:
1. Install the plugin
2. Connect your FastSocial account with your API key
3. Connect your social accounts in the FastSocial dashboard
4. Every new WordPress post you publish is automatically shared

Links are automatically stripped from X/Twitter and TikTok posts to prevent spam flags.

External Services

This plugin connects to the FastSocial service (https://fastsocial.ai) to provide its core functionality.

What is FastSocial?
FastSocial is a social media scheduling and publishing platform. The plugin sends your WordPress post content to the FastSocial API, which then distributes it to your connected social media accounts (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X/Twitter, TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube).

What data is sent and when?
When a WordPress post is published (or scheduled), the plugin sends the following data to the FastSocial API:
– Post title, excerpt, and/or custom caption
– Post URL (optional, can be disabled in settings)
– Featured image URL (optional, can be disabled in settings)
– Selected publishing platform(s)
– Your FastSocial API key (for authentication)

Data is only sent when auto-publish is enabled and a post is published. No data is sent passively or in the background.

FastSocial service links:
– Website: https://fastsocial.ai
– Terms of Service: https://fastsocial.ai/terms-of-service
– Privacy Policy: https://fastsocial.ai/privacy-policy

Third-party libraries:
This plugin includes FullCalendar (https://fullcalendar.io), an open-source JavaScript calendar library licensed under the MIT License. It is used to display the scheduling calendar in the WordPress admin. No data is sent to FullCalendar servers.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the fastsocial folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Go to FastSocial → Settings and enter your API key
  4. Get your API key at fastsocial.ai/developer
  5. Click Test Connection to verify
sections.faq:
Do I need a FastSocial account?

Yes. A free FastSocial account lets you connect one platform and use auto-publish. Pro ($20/mo) unlocks the calendar, media browser, and multi-platform posting.

Which platforms are supported?

Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X (Twitter), TikTok, Pinterest, and YouTube.

Does the plugin post immediately or can I schedule?

The free auto-publish feature posts when your WordPress post is published. With Pro, you can schedule posts to any date and time via the calendar.

Are links included in posts?

Yes, by default. Links are automatically removed from X/Twitter and TikTok posts to prevent spam flags, but remain in all other platform posts.

What languages are supported?

109 languages via the language selector in plugin settings.
